audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 disagreed with the packet chart and with their own prose: whys[1] says his poke and double Hop outrange you with 'no real return trade yet' but the chart said Skill; whys[2] literally calls Level 3 'a coin-flip' but the chart said Gragas.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Gragas, Gnar, Gragas, Gragas. Rows 1 and 2 were one step optimistic in both layers.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side -> Gnar and win[2]/phases[2].side -> Skill, with phases[0..2].why rewritten to state the reason. Proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried no cooldowns at all — 'his key tool', 'your committal tool', 'your ultimate'.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30, Hop/Crunch 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, Wallop 7s; Body Slam 14s at rank 1 and Explosive Cask 100s. The rank-1 GNAR! at 90s and Hop at 22s are the two timers that decide when you can commit.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and tradeGood now carry 90s, 22s, 14s and 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].t said 'Stand near walls for Mega-E'. The wall interaction belongs to GNAR! (R), not to Crunch (E) — Riot's E text is a leap that lands with area damage and no wall effect, while R states any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage. tradeBad also said a whiffed Body Slam is '13 seconds'.
audit.why: Telling the player to fear walls during Mega-E sends them to the wrong ability and the wrong cooldown; the actual punish is a 90s ultimate. Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].t retargeted onto GNAR!, tradeBad/dontsFull[2].d state the Wallop counter-stun and the correct 14s, and breakdown.cooldowns names the wall-stun bonus on R.

notes: No prior gragas__gnar mirror existed; the mirrorFindings shown are the gnar-side pass. This side now states the same facts inverted: Gnar ahead levels 1-2, coin-flip at 3, Gragas from 4-5, Gnar at 6 with Mega banked, Gragas from first item. Row 1 and row 2 flips are one atomic group across both layers. The 'Mega-E stuns you into walls' claim was wrong and is retargeted onto GNAR! (R), where Riot's text actually puts the wall stun.
